page_title: UDI 2-3 FIO | Udinese v Fiorentina 25/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Fiorentina take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+5' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
90+4' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
90+4' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom left corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Fiorentina are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
89' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) for his blatant foul.
86' Substitution. Matteo Palma (Udinese) on for Kingsley Ehizibue.
86' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Keinan Davis (Udinese).
85' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) replacing Lucas Beltran.
82' 2 - 3 Goal! Robin Gosens passes the ball to Moise Kean (Fiorentina) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Maduka Okoye couldn't do anything about it. 2:3.
80' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is quickest to the rebound and shoots towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
79' Here comes a substitution. Pietro Comuzzo is given a rest as he is replaced by Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina).
79' Fiorentina quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
78' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Lorenzo Lucca is replaced by Keinan Davis (Udinese).
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arthur Atta leaves the pitch and Iker Bravo (Udinese) comes on.
77' The ball goes out for a corner. Fiorentina can continue in their attacking effort.

76' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Maduka Okoye inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
76' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
75' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
75' Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

73' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the middle of the goal, Maduka Okoye didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is coming onto the pitch as Amir Richardson cannot continue after picking up an injury.
69' Fiorentina control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
67' The current number of shots on goal is 3:4.
63' The ball is out of play and Fiorentina manage to earn a corner.
63' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
61' 2 - 2 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Christian Kabasele (Udinese), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 2:2.
61' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) leaps like a salmon and plants a great close-range header from the corner towards goal, but the effort is blocked at the last moment.
61' Arthur Atta (Udinese) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
60' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matteo Marcenaro had an easy-decision to make.

59' The cross into the penalty area from Jordan Zemura (Udinese) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
57' 1 - 2 GOAL! Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Amir Richardson provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 1:2.
57' Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
55' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Maduka Okoye intercepts the ball.
52' The referee signals a substitution. Oier Zarraga (Udinese) is brought on as a substitute for Alexis Sanchez.
52' The linesman points to the corner flag, Fiorentina are going to take it.
52' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

46' 1 - 1 Goal! Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Maduka Okoye is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
46' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
46' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Matteo Marcenaro has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+2' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Fiorentina was in an offside position.
43' Some neat passing and movement from Fiorentina as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
39' RED CARD! Jaka Bijol (Udinese) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Matteo Marcenaro. He can have an early bath.
34' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
30' The game is interrupted now, Christian Kabasele (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

26' 1 - 0 Goal! Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. David de Gea is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:0.
26' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Robin Gosens (Fiorentina). The ball is out of play. Fiorentina will have a throw-in.
25' Maduka Okoye displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Moise Kean (Fiorentina) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
22' A cross from Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
19' The ball goes out of play and Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
17' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Udinese will take a free kick near the side line.
13' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes.
9' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marcenaro and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
6' Fiorentina force a corner. They send men into the box.
2' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Moise Kean (Fiorentina) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Udinese will kick-off.
Matteo Marcenaro will referee today's match.
